scope: MODEL-02 local extraction; no external text requests, no new generative model; no hidden corpus access

alternatives.name: keep sentence-only cosine and raise threshold
alternatives.reason: negation and quoted commands can remain semantically close; higher threshold loses paraphrases without resolving eligibility

alternatives.name: topic keyword rules
alternatives.reason: cannot recover keyword-free paraphrases and duplicates a separate topic classifier

alternatives.name: full local generative entailment model
alternatives.reason: new download, slower CPU and unvalidated Korean inference; existing embedding runtime is sufficient for a conservative bounded experiment

alternatives.name: conservative eligibility plus contextual embeddings
alternatives.reason: separate whether a passage can support an inference from which topic it resembles; keep exact original evidence and explicit limits

eligibility: Deterministic structural filters exclude quoted/code/transcript-like instructions, imperative directives, explicit negated interest/activity and historically discontinued interests. Split a Korean contrastive 아니라/아닌/말고 construction and consider its positive remainder, retaining original offsets. These are abstention rules, not a full Korean parser; ordinary external-authored statements remain eligible as saved material.
embedding: Topic prototypes use existing fixed topic terms plus existing description. Score exact evidence passage (70%) and eligible neighboring context (30%), with each independently required to meet a conservative floor. No lexical topic matching.
coverage: Split long sentences instead of discarding their tail; sample 12 windows/document by original character position including document edges; sample 8 explicit question windows separately. Report exact sampled character coverage and dropped-window counts; no whole-document understanding claim.
resultContract: Preserve workspaceId/scopeRevision/analysis/limitations. Retain existing document and evidence shape. Add saved_material evidenceScope/evidenceLabel and aggregate diagnostics without raw text.
preservation: Keep selected-version SHA checks, raw UTF-16 quote locations, author/coverage caveats, body-hash dedup, late-result invalidation, lifecycle cancel/dispose/retry logic. Runtime injection/default fail closed belongs to separate loader.
limitations: Heuristic eligibility can miss indirect negation or exclude useful quoted source material. It never proves authorship, agreement, current interest or beliefs.
Bounded sampling can miss local topics in very long documents; diagnostics expose the analyzed fraction.
Embeddings do not prove that questions are logically identical; require independent bodies and pairwise passage/context agreement.
Original MODEL01 missing tail remains unavailable; this is a new implementation with recovered-prefix provenance.
freeze: Freeze implementation and thresholds after synthetic focused regressions, before independent hidden heldout is evaluated. Report heldout failures without tuning implementation on them.
